avis.titre: Go with Hero Mighty Patches instead
avis.texte: I've purchased these several times before because they kinda worked (but not always), but yesterday I impulsively picked up the Hero Mighty Patches instead. I'm so glad I did, because a painful zit erupted on my neck later that day! Truly's stars are difficult to apply because of the shape. It's hard to peel them off the plastic and I usually end up bending the star's points. They're also so small that they're difficult to apply; and while they're a cute shape, they're hardly discreet. Meanwhile, the Mighty Patches cover more area and are much harder to notice. (They also have an invisible version that I haven't tried.) They're easy to apply, and I got much better results than I was able to with Truly's stars. I don't work for Hero Cosmetics, and up until yesterday, I thought I was pretty loyal to these stars. But I'm here to tell you as a friend, you want the Mighty Patch. Run, don't walk.

These work really well to smooth out and shrink blemishes! I have had an annoying hormonal under the skin zit under my chin and after putting one of these stars on and leaving it on for 12 hours, it came to a head! These also stop me from touching/ picking at blemishes and they're so cute! I don't mind if someone sees me in one. If you're looking for hydrocolloid patches where you can really see the gunk that it pulls out, these aren't it. It's hard to see what it pulls out when you take it off. They're also a tiny bit small for some of my larger blemishes. But they're great for small areas you want to shrink quickly. I've already told several friends about these! Now I want all the shapes!

I love these. They look adorable so I don't mind running errands with them on, but the effectiveness gets these a 5 star rating. I have very fair skin and scar very easily, it usually takes a long time for my zits to heal. These knock out red marks in about 3 days, I've found. Wear them as long as you possibly can. The difference between wearing them for 8 hours versus 12 hours is stark. They're not super sticky at first, but they WILL adhere to your skin and stay on all day (I literally wore them to a water park and they did not come off). If you plan on using these you cannot use any oils or heavy moisturizers. You HAVE to use something light with good absorption. I use la roche posay toleriane double repair, for example. Wait about 10 minutes before you let your face hit the pillow to give them time to settle on.
